pairs.evidence: src/features/notepad/plan/shipReadinessPublish.ts:181 The persisted ship-readiness snapshot that Athena reads in later sessions is stamped only with a schema version and a single write-time publishedAt. There is no immutable identifier of the state it observed and no version of the criteria derivation. Milestones from other projects, carried forward verbatim from the stored document (line 180), are re-stamped with the new time, so their age is misreported.

techniques.evidence: src/features/notepad/plan/shipReadinessPublish.ts:181 The stamp has one document-level time and no binding to the observed state or the instrument. Kept entries inherit a fresh publishedAt. A version mismatch returns [] at line 156 and the next write replaces the store, so there is no migrate-on-read.

src/features/notepad/plan/useProjectPlan.ts:170 Context tone and the ship verdict come from live Sentry errors and KPI wiring, not from the plan or the operator's ratings. Unwired monitoring is null, not zero.
src/features/notepad/plan/useProjectPlan.ts:97 The surface is scoped to one project. Its blocker lines (line 203) are per-feature, and there is no portfolio to roll up across.
